welcome.title: Every receipt, read line by line.
welcome.body: See what you really buy, what got dearer, and how much is left this month.

money.title: Language and money
money.body: We guessed from your browser. Change anything.
money.nbp: Receipts in other currencies are converted at the NBP rate.

look.title: Pick your look
look.body: Charts follow the palette too. Change it any time in Settings.

income.title: What comes in a month?
income.body: So Home can show what is left. Optional, and only you see it.

security.title: Lock it with a code
security.body: Two-factor sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
security.nowHint: A QR code, then 10 recovery codes
security.laterHint: Your password alone signs you in

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Snap your first receipt — it takes about ten seconds.

accounts.title: Where is your money?
accounts.body: Start with the card you pay with: purchases come off it by themselves.
accounts.cardHint: Leave the amount empty to skip; add accounts later on Plan.
accounts.cardHintShared: It is shared with your family, and pays for everyone’s purchases.
accounts.business: I also have a business account
accounts.businessHint: Money from clients sets your tax aside, and the rest counts as the family’s income.
accounts.later: Savings, a shared card and monthly transfers can be added any time.
accounts.familyCard: Your family pays for purchases from “{{name}}”: they come off it for you too.

family.title: Budget together?
family.body: Share receipts, income and bills with your family. Each of you keeps private what you want.
family.aloneHint: You can start a family later in Settings
family.name: Family name
family.invite: Send this link to whoever you share money with:
